[LADP.4.8.1] A `logical` schema an adapter generates carries
`key` / `mutable` markers on every slot like any other
`logical` schema (require-all, [LFAC.1.7.4]). The identity
slot — `entity_id` for discovery-driven
adapters ([LADP.4.3.1]), `topic` or the per-adapter equivalent
key for author-declared adapters ([LADP.4.4.1]) — must be among
the `key` slots: it is the external identifier, which is the
fact's identity.
